parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter is valid only when you leave TagKey.N empty. Valid values:

- true: Remove all tags.

- false: Do not remove all tags.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Service Mesh instance is located.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the Service Mesh instances.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: A required parameter. The value must be `servicemesh`.
